subject: Merchant-led pilot: top-up request for Opal Retail (marketplace credits)
messages:
From: Priya Nair <priya.nair@cloudscale.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: partners@nimbleworks.io; pilot@opalretail.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Merchant-led pilot: request to top up partner credits for Opal Retail

Hi Rafael,

Hope you’re well — quick ask on behalf of CloudScale Partners. We have an ongoing merchant-led pilot with Opal Retail (pilot started 2026-07-01) where our SI, NimbleWorks, is co-sponsoring implementation and success ops. The pilot usage is higher than forecast due to a catalog ingestion step; Opal is asking for an extra $7.5k of marketplace credits so they can extend the trial by two additional weeks and finish the PoC.

Details:
- Customer: Opal Retail (Retail merch tech)
- Current pilot end: 2026-08-21
- Requested top-up: $7,500 marketplace credit (voucher/activation preferred)
- Co-sponsor: NimbleWorks (SI) — willing to cover 50% of the top-up (we can escrow)
- HubSpot deal id: DL-2026-3319

Attached is our partner commitment memo (cloudscale_credit_commitment.pdf) and a short usage excerpt. Can Redwood approve a conditional top-up routed from partner promo pool or create a marketplace voucher tied to the deal? We need activation before 2026-08-20 to avoid service interruption.

Appreciate a fast turnaround — happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Nair
Partnerships Ops | CloudScale Partners
attachments: cloudscale_credit_commitment.pdf
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Priya Nair <priya.nair@cloudscale.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Merchant-led pilot: request to top up partner credits for Opal Retail

Hi Priya — thanks for the note and the attachment. Looping in Kimberly from Partner Ops / Finance for approval routing.

Quick read: this looks like a typical partner-sourced top-up where the partner (CloudScale) is co-funding with the SI. A couple of clarifying questions before I route for final sign-off:
- Can CloudScale confirm a written pledge of the 50% contribution (PDF ok) and whether that funds come from your marketplace pool or direct invoice to Redwood?
- Are there any export/compliance constraints on Opal’s data (they’re in the EU)? We’ll need a brief attestation for Private Data handling if so.

Proposed next steps:
1) If CloudScale can confirm the pledge and provide a signed commitment, we can provision a voucher tied to DL-2026-3319 for $7,500 with expiry 2026-10-31.
2) We’ll create conditional ledger entries (partner escrow) and require a short co-sponsor acknowledgment from NimbleWorks.
3) Once approved, Finance will generate an activation code and I’ll send the voucher to Opal with usage guardrails.

I’ll attach a one-page summary for approvals (summary-topup.xlsx) and will mark this as time-sensitive. Kimberly — if you’re good with the conditional flow above, can you please confirm by EOD?

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
attachments: summary-topup.xlsx

Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:22:00 -0400

Rafael / Priya — thanks for the clear summary. I’m comfortable approving a conditional $7,500 voucher routed as follows: Redwood issues a $7,500 marketplace voucher tied to DL-2026-3319; CloudScale escrows $3,750 (50%) and NimbleWorks signs a co-sponsor acknowledgment. Activation window: must be used by 2026-10-31.

Requirements before activation (compliance / finance):
- CloudScale to provide signed pledge (PDF).
- NimbleWorks to confirm support and sign co-sponsor note.
- Finance to complete ledger entry and confirm no outstanding billing flags on Opal Retail.

I’ll authorize Partner Ops to create the voucher once Finance confirms. I’m attaching a short approval stub (approval-note.txt) for record. Rafael / Sofia — please coordinate finance clearance and send me confirmation.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Director, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
attachments: approval-note.txt
